# Highland Roasters Wholesale

Highland Roasters has been sourcing and roasting speciality coffee for over fifteen years. Our wholesale programme serves cafes, restaurants and workplaces that care about quality and traceability, with beans bought directly from farms we visit every harvest season.

## Coffee for workplaces

Workplace customers choose from our seasonal espresso, a classic filter roast and a Swiss water process decaf. Every coffee comes with notes on origin, farm and flavour profile, which many teams enjoy sharing in the office kitchen.

FACT: Highland Roasters charges 16 dollars per kg for wholesale workplace coffee.
FACT: Highland Roasters delivers every 2 weeks to workplace accounts.
FACT: Highland Roasters requires a minimum order of 5 kg per delivery.

## Sustainability

All our coffees are either certified fair trade or purchased through direct trade relationships that pay well above market price. Deliveries arrive in recyclable bags, and we collect used packaging on our next visit. Spent coffee grounds can be collected for composting on request.

## Equipment

Highland Roasters does not lease machines directly, but we partner with an independent equipment company that can supply and service espresso and filter machines. Our team will recommend a setup that suits your office size and coffee style, and we provide free barista training for staff who want to learn.

## Accounts and billing

Workplace accounts are invoiced monthly with thirty day payment terms. There is no long-term contract, and deliveries can be paused during office closures or holidays with one week of notice.

## Visit us

Office managers are welcome to book a visit to our roastery to see how the coffee is made and taste the current range before ordering.
